title: Chat Interface Endpoints
summary: This module provides various API endpoints for interacting with the chat system, including basic chat, gate-controlled chat, and persona-steered chat, with both synchronous and streaming options.

nodes.label: Gate Chat Request
nodes.title: Gate Chat Request
nodes.description: Handles incoming requests for gate-controlled chat interactions, applying gate logic before generating a response.

nodes.label: Gate Chat Stream Request
nodes.title: Gate Chat Stream Request
nodes.description: Manages streaming responses for gate-controlled chat, sending events as they are generated.

nodes.label: Rotating Gate Test Request
nodes.title: Rotating Gate Test Request
nodes.description: Provides a streaming endpoint for testing rotating gate configurations within the chat system.

nodes.label: Persona Steered Chat Request
nodes.title: Persona Steered Chat Request
nodes.description: Processes chat requests that involve steering the persona's response based on specified parameters.

nodes.label: Persona Steered Chat Stream Request
nodes.title: Persona Steered Chat Stream Request
nodes.description: Handles streaming responses for persona-steered chat, delivering real-time updates.

nodes.label: Basic Chat Request
nodes.title: Basic Chat Request
nodes.description: Manages standard chat requests without advanced gate or persona steering logic.

nodes.label: Basic Chat Stream Request
nodes.title: Basic Chat Stream Request
nodes.description: Provides a streaming interface for basic chat interactions, sending token-by-token responses.

nodes.label: Run Gate Agent Turn
nodes.title: Run Gate Agent Turn
nodes.description: Executes a single turn of the gate agent, applying gate logic and generating a response based on current state and messages.

nodes.label: Generate Steered Response
nodes.title: Generate Steered Response
nodes.description: Generates a chat response that is influenced by a specific persona vector and steering alpha.

nodes.label: Language Model Pipeline
nodes.title: Language Model Pipeline
nodes.description: Represents the underlying language model and tokenizer used for generating chat responses.

groups.label: Gate Chat Endpoints
groups.title: Gate Chat Endpoints
groups.description: API endpoints for chat interactions controlled by gate logic, including both synchronous and streaming responses.

groups.label: Persona Steered Endpoints
groups.title: Persona Steered Endpoints
groups.description: API endpoints for chat interactions where the persona's response is steered by specific parameters, supporting both synchronous and streaming modes.

groups.label: Basic Chat Endpoints
groups.title: Basic Chat Endpoints
groups.description: Standard API endpoints for general chat interactions, offering both immediate and streaming responses.

groups.label: Chat Logic
groups.title: Chat Logic
groups.description: Core components responsible for processing chat requests, applying steering, and interacting with the language model.
